rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=128, naf_layers=4, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.01, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-1 feasibility (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). GOAL: does naf (Neural Attenuation Field, per-scene self-supervised INR -- one coordinate-MLP optimized PER L277 slice against its OWN sinogram, no training set) run on Mayo under the corrected path (staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, inlined single-val-ps probe -> reconstructs at L277 native ps ~0.73979, bg_target=truth) and produce a FINITE val_score + comparison.png within the HARD 20-min budget, scoring ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override)? BUDGET REASONING (the load-bearing decision): NAF has NO training (train_n=0); the ENTIRE budget is the per-scene fit loop, total = val_n x per_scene. val=ALL 214 L277 slices is MANDATORY (protocol; do NOT reduce). 18-min outer wall (naf_outer_wall_s=1080, inside the 20-min compute budget, leaving headroom for the figure+IO before the 30-min sbatch kill) / 214 scenes = naf_per_scene_s=5.0 s/scene. Mayo is 512x512 images at 2304 views x 736 channels, so each Adam step = a 512^2 MLP forward + a 2304-view fan-beam forward-project + backward = EXPENSIVE; 5 s/scene buys only a handful of steps (a NeRF-style fit wants hundreds-to-thousands). naf_n_iter=3000 is a HIGH CAP so the PER-SCENE WALL (t_limit in fit_one_scene), NOT the iter count, is the governor -- each scene runs as many steps as fit in 5 s. To squeeze the most out of the tiny budget: leaner MLP than default (hidden 192->128, layers 5->4, n_freqs 10->8 => cheaper steps => a few more fit per scene) and naf_lr 5e-3->1e-2 (with only a handful of steps, a higher lr converges faster from the water-mu init). naf_n_clip=0.05 (sigmoid head out_scale), naf_tv_weight=1e-4 defaults. HYPOTHESIS: NAF is STRUCTURALLY FBP-bounded on dense rebinned Mayo (wrong inductive bias for dense-view CT -- solver_plan.md flags NAF/R2G hr~0 on dense-view; the discarded boundary-slice run hinted naf 0.911 < LD-FBP ~0.81-cal baseline, a behavior hint only) AND it is BUDGET-STARVED on the 214-slice protocol (5 s/scene = far too few per-scene Adam steps for a NeRF-style convergence). Expect val_ssim that does NOT clear the LD-FBP baseline (hr near 0). This iter ESTABLISHES that datapoint under the corrected metric -- a real finding (do NOT reduce val_n below 214 to make NAF look better). iter-2+ will tune ONE knob (per-scene step budget vs MLP capacity vs lr) but NAF cannot escape its structural ceiling on this dense substrate within a 20-min/214-scene budget.

(2) FAILURE MODE: budget-starved per-scene INR fit. A NeRF-style coordinate-MLP wants hundreds-to-thousands of Adam steps to leave its water-mu init; ~91 steps/scene leaves the MLP barely moved -> SSIM 0.4729 well below the LD-FBP baseline. This is starvation, NOT (yet) the structural floor. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_hidden 128->64 (naf_layers=4, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_lr=1e-2, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214 ALL UNCHANGED). 214-SCENE 20-MIN BUDGET MATH (measured): the entire budget is the per-scene fit loop (train_n=0); total = 214 x per_scene_s = 214 x 5.0s = 1070s ~= the 1080s/18-min outer wall, hit exactly at scene 214. I CANNOT raise per_scene_s (214 x wall is already full inside the 20-min compute budget). So to buy MORE Adam steps per scene at FIXED total budget I make each step CHEAPER: per-step cost ~0.055 s/step is the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward PLUS the tunable 512^2-coord MLP forward; halving width 128->64 cuts the dominant hidden x hidden matmuls ~4x, so each 5.0s scene should fit meaningfully more steps -> more useful optimization per scene within the SAME 214 x 1080s/18-min wall. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I shrink naf_hidden 128->64, I expect SSIM to rise above 0.4729 because the cheaper MLP buys more Adam steps per scene, letting the INR move further off its water-mu init within the same per-scene wall. FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays ~0.47 despite more steps, NAF is STRUCTURALLY FBP-bounded on dense rebinned Mayo (wrong inductive bias for dense-view CT), not merely starved. (5) HARD 20-min budget: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18 min) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall = the governor; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a high cap), val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices, NOT reduced), 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override). (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.

column13: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=64, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.01, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-3 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX. (1) NUMBERS trajectory: iter-1 naf_hidden=128 -> SSIM 0.4729, hr 0.0, PSNR 18.55, baseline_PSNR 34.08, elapsed 1097s, median ~91 Adam steps/scene (5.0s per-scene wall), 18-min outer wall (1080s) hit EXACTLY at scene 214 (1082.5s). iter-2 naf_hidden=128->64 (cheaper hiddenxhidden matmuls -> more steps/scene) -> SSIM 0.4943, hr 0.0, PSNR 18.62, elapsed 1100s: +0.0215 SSIM, CONFIRMING the budget-starvation diagnosis (cheaper step -> more per-scene optimization -> higher SSIM). Still FAR below the LD-FBP floor (~0.81 cal). (2) FAILURE MODE: budget-starved per-scene INR fit. A NeRF-style coordinate-MLP wants hundreds-to-thousands of Adam steps to leave its water-mu init; ~91 steps/scene at hidden=128 (more at hidden=64) leaves the INR barely off init. iter-2's +0.0215 proves we are still on the starvation slope, NOT yet at the structural floor. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_layers 4->3 (naf_hidden=64, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_lr=1e-2, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214 ALL UNCHANGED). The hidden-width lever was spent in iter-2; the next leanness step is MLP DEPTH. NAF.__init__ builds [Linear(in,h),ReLU] + (layers-2) x [Linear(h,h),ReLU] + Linear(h,1); at layers=4 that is TWO hiddenxhidden blocks, at layers=3 it is ONE -> removing one full 64x64 Linear+ReLU cuts the per-step MLP matmul cost ~1/3 (over 512^2=262144 coords each step) on top of the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward. 214-SCENE 20-MIN BUDGET MATH (measured): train_n=0, the ENTIRE budget is the per-scene fit loop; total = 214 x per_scene_s = 214 x 5.0s = 1070s ~= the 1080s/18-min outer wall, hit exactly at scene 214 (verified both iters). I CANNOT raise per_scene_s (214 x wall already fills the 20-min compute budget). So to buy MORE Adam steps per scene at FIXED 214x1080s total I make each step CHEAPER again: layers 4->3 drops one 64x64 block -> more steps fit in each 5.0s scene within the SAME wall. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I shrink naf_layers 4->3, I expect SSIM to rise above 0.4943 because the shallower MLP buys more Adam steps per scene, letting the INR move further off its water-mu init within the same per-scene wall (same mechanism that gave iter-2 +0.0215). FALSIFIER: if SSIM stalls at ~0.49 (or drops) despite the extra steps, NAF is STRUCTURALLY FBP-bounded on dense rebinned Mayo (wrong inductive bias for dense-view CT) AND/OR has lost too much MLP capacity to represent the slice -> document the per-scene-INR ceiling on dense Mayo as a NEGATIVE result (SSIM ~0.5 vs LD-FBP ~0.81). (5) HARD 20-min budget: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18 min, in-solver outer wall = governor) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a high cap so the WALL governs, not the iter count), val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices, NOT reduced), 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override). (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
